messages:
Ajay: Heads-up — planning a coordinated version hop to v0.15.0 across api, runtime, console, and SDKs. Target cutover today ~15:00 PT. Need final checks on changelogs, compat, and CI.
Maria: Ok, which repos exactly? and who owns changelog entries?
Ajay: Repos: repo/redwood-api, repo/redwood-runtime, repo/console, repo/sdk-js, repo/sdk-py. I'll open PRs for api/runtime/console. SDKs handled by Taylor. Changelog: please add short bullets to CHANGELOG.md in each repo — Maria can you shepherd api + console?
Maria: Yep, I can add api + console entries in a single PR. Will keep them terse: latency fixes, batching tweak, small API param rename.
Taylor: I will regen SDKs after console PR merges. gen script: `./scripts/gen-sdks.sh` — note SDK JS needs peerDep bump for node-fetch. ETA ~10min once kicked.
Jamie: I can take runtime review. @Ajay please include a brief note on KV cache behavior change so I can focus smoke tests.
Ajay: Runtime change: sliding KV cache TTL reduced from 5m -> 2m to reduce mem growth. No API surface break, but perf profile changes. I'll add a short blurb in the PR.
Kelsey: Rollback plan? If runtime causes perf regressions we should be able to flip traffic to v0.14 in routing for Dedicated for ~30m. Who will monitor metrics during canary?
Jamie: I'll watch p50/p95 and error budget, and trigger rollback if p95 increases >20% or errors +1%.
release-bot: release checklist created: checklist/4123456789-v0.15.0 (canary window, smoke tests, SDK publish).
Ajay: Links: runtime PR https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/1423, console PR https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/778, api PR https://git.internal/redwood/api/pull/916. SDK PRs will be posted by Taylor.
Taylor: SDK PRs: sdk-js PR https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pull/210, sdk-py PR https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-py/pull/88 (draft). Will push final after console merge.
Maria: Quick ask — please ensure CHANGELOG entries include migration note for the API param rename (oldParam -> newParam). I will add an example snippet.
Ajay: Good catch. I'll add the sample curl for migration.
Jamie: Running runtime smoke locally now, posting results in ~12m. If green, I'll approve.
Taylor: SDK gen ran into one failing test (auth header matcher) — quick fix pushed to branch, re-running CI.
Kelsey: Canary plan: stage for 2h, then slow ramp to prod over 30m if green. Ops alert channel: #incidents will be on watch.
Ajay: Cutoff reminder: Please have all PRs merged by 14:15 PT to allow canary rollout at 15:00. If any blockers, post here ASAP.
Maria: I've updated api + console changelogs and pinged @frontend for console review.
Jamie: Runtime smoke looks fine on my run: p50 stable, p95 +3%, errors unchanged. Approving runtime PR.
Taylor: SDKs green now. Publishing sdk-js to npm and sdk-py wheel after tag. Will post publish links.
release-bot: deployment note: canary started at 4123456890, target 2h window.
Ajay: Publishing tag command I used for tagging runtime: ```git tag -a v0.15.0 -m "release v0.15.0" && git push origin v0.15.0```
Kelsey: I'll monitor dashboards and have rollback steps ready. Thx all.
Maria: LGTM from api/console side.
Taylor: sdk-js: published https://npm.pkg.redwood/sdk-js v0.15.0; sdk-py: wheel uploaded to internal PyPI.
Ajay: Thanks everyone — assuming no regressions we proceed to prod ramp after canary window. If anything unexpected, call it out in this thread or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
